name: Tackhead
hook: Sugar Hill's own former house rhythm section, rebuilt in London as a dub-industrial unit.
blurb: Guitarist Skip McDonald, bassist Doug Wimbish and drummer Keith LeBlanc had been Sugar Hill Records' in-house rhythm section, playing on early hip-hop records including 'The Message'. As Sugar Hill's money collapsed, they left and came together again in London as Tackhead, produced by Adrian Sherwood on his label On-U Sound, fusing dub, funk and industrial noise. They are a direct link between two labels on this map, carrying a hip-hop rhythm section's power into dub and industrial music.

signatureTracks.title: Rebel Discharge Vs Tricky Kid
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: The clearest fusion of the group's Sugar Hill-honed rhythm section with Sherwood's dub-industrial production.

signatureTracks.title: Question Time
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: Political sample collage over the same rhythm section, showing the industrial side of the project's range.
